source_snapshot.procedure: Boot OS; run `ipmitool chassis bootparam get 5`; check Boot type.
source_snapshot.criteria: Boot Type status should be literal `udfi`.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES/read-only, but silently interprets the criterion as UEFI.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: FULLY AUTOMATABLE/LOW after owner confirms the apparent typo and selector-5 mapping.

old_problem: The Master acceptance token `udfi` is undefined, while prior AI silently changed it to UEFI. Selector 5 also contains valid, persistent/one-time and EFI fields, so a loose text match does not prove either the configured next boot or the running OS mode.
disposition_reason: The read command is standard and safe, but ED-15 forbids PASS without an approved oracle and the conflict rule forbids silently correcting Master. Target and decoder can be parameterized only after the owner disposes `udfi`; therefore the source conflict and decision remain.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX rows 2247 and 2248, same-row AI fields, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed.
Preserve literal `ipmitool chassis bootparam get 5` and `udfi` as source evidence.
Run only a protected read-only get on the verified local controller; retain full stdout/stderr/exit and raw bytes if supported.
Decode valid, persistence and EFI/legacy bits using the approved client/firmware mapping; OS UEFI evidence is corroboration, not a substitute.
Do not set boot parameters, reboot, normalize `udfi`, retry or decide a DUT verdict.
No login, query, boot change or DUT action was executed.

test_case.test_name: IPMI selector-5 boot-type decode with unresolved `udfi` criterion
test_case.purpose: Read the intended BMC's selector-5 boot flags and compare the approved EFI/legacy state while preserving the undefined Master acceptance token for owner disposition.
required_package: Verified SUT/BMC/BIOS/OS and protected in-band ipmitool path
Approved correction or literal meaning of `udfi`
Firmware/client-specific selector-5 raw and formatted decoder
Authoritative next/persistent boot policy and optional running-OS corroboration
test_case.test_command: After the oracle is approved, execute exactly `ipmitool chassis bootparam get 5` once on the bound controller; preserve full output/exit/raw flags and decode validity, persistence and EFI state without any set or reboot.
test_case.expected_result: The valid selector-5 fields decode exactly to the owner-approved UEFI/legacy policy and any OS corroboration agrees within its declared scope.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires an approved `udfi` disposition plus deterministic raw/formatted decoding and policy match. Undefined token, invalid/stale flags, ambiguous one-time versus persistent state or decoder mismatch remains BLOCKED/PENDING; text containing UEFI alone cannot pass.
safety_gate: Read-only selector 5 on the verified controller only.
No bootparam set, boot override, reboot or power action.
Stop on wrong controller, unsupported selector or ambiguous flags.
Do not silently rewrite the Master criterion.
expected_evidence: Complete stdout/stderr/exit and raw selector flags
Optional OS boot-mode corroboration and no-change audit
test_case.recovery: No state change is expected; on ambiguity stop, preserve raw output and escalate without corrective boot operations.
